notes: Biggest single pattern: pastors’ meetings. Six regional ministerial area meetings plus African, Haitian and Korean ministerial meetings recur every month, and Spanish Ministries holds its own. Pastoral-leadership comes to about 190 occurrences in the window, most of them these meetings. The calendar is pastor-centred before it is anything else.

Health is strong on the calendar: 17 "DELIVERANCE weekend on the road" health weekends, a DELIVERANCE week at camp meeting, a breast-cancer awareness walk, and the Impact Philly health clinic (7–9 Aug 2026).

Evangelism shows up as campaigns, not as a steady rhythm: Reach Baltimore with Chesapeake (Oct 2025), Spanish crusades in Baltimore (Oct 2025), Impact Philly (week of prayer, HOPE Fest and clinic, Compassion meetings, Aug–Sept 2026), Spanish small-group crusades (Mar and Sept 2026), PELC (Dec 2025).

Statement compared with calendar: the draft "Refresh AEC" plan promises an "AEC School of Evangelism" with quarterly training and certification (50+ certified evangelists by Dec 2026). No session with that name appears anywhere in the calendar (searched all 1,570 entries).

Multilingual ministry is very visible: 37 conference events carry multilingual as their second category (Spanish, Haitian, Korean, African). Spanish Ministries alone run zone trainings, youth congress, crusades, retreats, VLP classes and a Pathfinder day.
Stewardship has a monthly Estate Planning class (third Tuesday) and Haitian financial-literacy trainings.
Excluded from counts: holidays/office closures (13), pay days and report deadlines (11), first-day-of-school dates (2), camp set-up "Camp Pitch" (5), private logistics (3), staff party (1).
Clinic in Baltimore (free medical/dental/vision, 25–28 Sept 2025, with Chesapeake) falls just before the window and is not counted.
